name: A factual reply states the facts and stops
bug_ref: 2026-07-31 user on a drafted close: 'I would never use this language' (feedback_email_no_editorializing, feedback_no_em_dashes)
brief:
Reply to Uma Yamamura (jules.dunmore4@example.edu) in the college communications office. Uma asked for a two or three sentence summary of the MapLab project for the college newsletter, due Friday.

Facts for the summary: the project builds a shared inference service for satellite image models on university hardware; the first users are three research groups in geography and computer science; the status page went live in September.

The reply gives the summary and says Uma can shorten it as needed.

No style profile exists for this contact: greet with "Hi Uma," and sign off with "{{first_name}}" on its own line.
rubric: The summary states the three facts plainly. No sentence tells the reader why the project matters or claims importance. No em-dash. Length fits a newsletter request: short.
